messages:
olivia_marketing: Quick check-in for the May 18 virtual event - final logistics thread. Need signoff on: reg page fields, Zoom recording options, and post-event lead routing. I sketched a barebones run-of-show below.

diego_ops: I drafted the Zoom settings in the event doc. Recommend cloud recording + local backup for host. Also enabling meeting passcode + auto-assign panelists as co-hosts.

maya_content: Registration page draft is live: title, 2-sentence blurb, 3 bullets (who should attend, what you'll learn, why Redwood's approach). CTA = "Reserve spot". Asking for email + name required, company and title optional (we want low friction). Added an optional "what are you building with LLMs?" free-text field.

noah_media: Recording plan: Cloud record (MP4) + transcript. Enable "save chat" and "record active speaker and gallery" if available. After event I'll export MP4 + transcript and run the clipper to make 45s social clips.

olivia_marketing: Zoe - confirm HubSpot mapping so registrants get a lifecycle stage and are tagged with campaign params. We also want an internal FAQ tag for attendees who asked about dedicated vs private deployments.

zoe_growth: Yup. Workflow: form submission -> create contact -> add tag webinar_may18 -> set property last_webinar=may18 -> push to list "webinar_inbound" -> notify AE channel. Also create lead task if attendee marked "interested_in_eval" in form.

diego_ops: Zoom settings I propose (paste):

```
- Auto-record: Cloud (host)
- Local backup: Host laptop (host must start if needed)
- Cloud transcript: ON
- Save chat: ON (including system messages)
- Allow participants to unmute: PANELISTS only
- Waiting room: OFF
- Passcode: enabled (in calendar invite)
- Co-hosts: noah_media, maya_content
- Alternative hosts: noah_media
```

maya_content: Minor ask - add checkbox on reg page for "I want the recording" so we can distinguish no-shows who still want the asset. Also add consent checkbox for marketing emails.

noah_media: Small correction: make sure Zoom is set to generate separate audio tracks for panelists, that helps when editing clips.

olivia_marketing: Post-event emails: Day 0 = Recording + TL;DR + 3 clip links. Day 3 = Use-case email with CTA to book demo. Day 10 = Nurture invite to office hours. Zoe, will you put the Day 0 + Day 3 drafts in the campaign folder?

zoe_growth: Done. Drafts are in /Marketing/Campaigns/May18. Day 0 includes UTM params utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=may18_launch. Also tagging attendees who asked "interested_in_eval".

deploybot: [automation] Zoom cloud folder monitor active. Will ping when new files appear in `zoom-cloud/redwood/may18`.

maya_content: Rehearsal scheduled May 17 9am PT. Please join 10m early. We'll test slides, demo VPN, and run audio checks.

olivia_marketing: Final checklist before I lock:
- reg page optional fields + consent checkbox -> maya checked
- zoom settings confirmed -> diego checked
- HubSpot flow + tags -> zoe checked
- media clipping pipeline -> noah checked

olivia_marketing: Locking this thread. If anything breaks on the day, update here and I'll escalate. Thanks team! :sparkles:
